manifest_file.description: Manifest inside output_dir; defaults to output_dir/manifest.json. Members are relative to the manifest parent.

allowed_extensions.description: Allowed attachment filename extensions (case-insensitive, with or without leading dot). Empty array disables the extension filter.

allowed_mime_prefixes.description: Allowed attachment MIME-type prefixes (case-insensitive). Empty array disables the mime filter. An attachment passes when either the extension filter or the mime filter accepts it (OR semantics).
